title: Meghalaya - Living Roots & Waterfalls
shortDescription: 5D/4N Dawki, Cherrapunji & Mawkdok. Homestays run by women, trek graded.
longDescription: Meghalaya is matrilineal - women own land, and now they lead your trek. Double decker root bridge with safety rope team.
highlights: Double Decker Trek with Local Women
itineraryChangePolicy: Rain may delay treks. Alternative waterfall visits. Safety over itinerary.

title: Kashmir Blossom - Houseboat Sisterhood
shortDescription: 5D/4N Srinagar-Gulmarg-Pahalgam women-only spring special. Tulip garden included.
longDescription: Imagine shikara rides at sunrise with only your girl gang, kahwa with stories, and a tulip garden that looks like heaven spilled. Every stay is verified, every driver is background-checked, trip leader is with you from arrival till drop. We share hotel names 7 days prior and keep a WhatsApp group active 48 hours before departure.
itineraryChangePolicy: In case of weather, curfew, or safety advisory, itinerary may change. You will be informed 12 hours prior with alternatives. No cost cutting.
